def _label(z, z_test, y, shared=True, tied=True):
    from scipy.optimize import least_squares
    (x, xt) = (_features(z, shared), _features(z_test, shared))
    lin = _affine(x)
    start = np.linalg.lstsq(lin, y, rcond=None)[0][1:]

    def design(x, p):
        index = x @ p[:-1] + p[-1]
        base = _affine(x) if not tied else np.column_stack((np.ones(len(x)), index))
        return np.column_stack((base, np.tanh(index)))

    def residual(p):
        d = design(x, p)
        return d @ np.linalg.lstsq(d, y, rcond=None)[0] - y
    fits = [least_squares(residual, np.r_[scale * start, 0.0], max_nfev=100) for scale in (0.6, 1.0, 1.6)]
    p = min(fits, key=lambda r: r.cost).x
    b = np.linalg.lstsq(design(x, p), y, rcond=None)[0]
    return design(xt, p) @ b

def _calibration(panel):
    """Fit each gain and offset after excluding reference-panel outliers."""
    coefficients = []
    for (u, v) in zip(panel['u'].T, panel['v'].T):
        design = _affine(u)
        keep = np.arange(len(u))
        for _ in range(3):
            c = _fit(design[keep], v[keep])
            residual = np.abs(v - design @ c)
            keep = np.argsort(residual)[:3 * len(u) // 4]
        good = residual <= 8 * np.median(residual)
        coefficients.append(_fit(design[good], v[good]))
    return np.asarray(coefficients).T

def solve_batch(study: dict) -> dict:
    train = study['train']
    (offset, gain) = _calibration(study['panel_a'])
    panel_b = study['panel_b']
    mixer = _fit(_affine(panel_b['u']), panel_b['v'])

    def coordinates(x):
        return _affine((x - offset) / gain) @ mixer
    z_train = coordinates(train['x'])
    z_test = coordinates(study['test']['x'])
    y_hat = _label_basis(z_test) @ _fit(_label_basis(z_train), train['y'])
    state_pred = _trajectory(_affine(z_train), train['traj'], _affine(z_test), study['eval_times'])
    final = state_pred[:, -1]
    diagnostics = np.array([y_hat.mean(), y_hat.std(), final.mean(), final.std()])
    return {'y_hat': y_hat, 'state_pred': state_pred, 'diagnostics_vec': diagnostics}
